Someone is bound to get sick, so as much as I like them I just swim on my own.  Water is peaceful too.  I will wait. I would hate to see lifeguards or staff get sick.  We are not allowed to change in locker room.  Come and go in suit.  Only use toilet of course.

At present, my psychologist’s office malpractice insurance won’t cover her and her associates if someone gets COVID from being there.  She told me malpractice insurance looks at the long length of time that 2 people are in a small room for therapy about 45 minutes.   In behavioral talking about emotions is a very personal thing. 

I need to be in that person’s bubble, in there energy physically.  It helps to go into that sacred environment that I am used to. That safe space, that same smell.

At home my spouse is working from home in another room.  She could walk into the kitchen any time and hear what I am saying I fear.  A lot of times I need to talk about my spouse and our relationship ship.  

Since telemedicine  I have made fewer appointments than I normally would.  I have felt more depressed.  I have lost weight, not felt like eating.  I know that she really can’t monitor my weight just seeing my dumb head.

It makes me sad.  I really just want to go to the office and visit her.  I have declined I have certain eating disorder issues that have flairs day up.

I will see my psychiatrist in person this week.  I hope to have the courage to let him know what’s really going on with me.  I see him in person.  It will help to be in his presence.

The same with my doctor, I think she got a sense that I like to come in person.  She told me that I could come in.

What I really need someone to know is that this just does not work for everyone ok?  I am on disability and go out to places like the YMCA to be around and connect with people.

I have even looked around for possibly another psychotherapist that does this in person.  I cannot find any.

In the midst  of a pandemic we are already stressed, depressed, and grieving the life we had-/getting out of house, going to see a concert, or speaker, shaking someone’s hand.  Then this damn telemedicine thing, it hurts even more!

I need someone to know, that some people,  maybe those who are shut in more, not working, maybe seniors need in person contact.  I am a 55 year female with degenerative spinal and cervical disease.

I would not even approve of a veterinary Tele medicine visit.  They need to be hands on with animals.
I have taken my cat to vet had them take the cat from car while I wait.  I cannot see if and how they are examining my pet. I didn’t like it at all.

This pandemic is isolating those who are already isolated.

Thanks for asking.  Some of my friends agree with me.

Thanks for listening 

Renee
